description: Internal autoconfig solver policy knobs (docs/AUTOCONFIG_MODEL.md; Python AutoconfigKnobs). Measured-policy constants with provenance — not user-facing dials. Loaded from autoconfig.json if not inlined.

vram_usable_fraction.description: Usable fraction of physical (BAR1) VRAM: 15/16 covers the driver/runtime reserve and reproduces the champion's declared 30/15 GiB on 32/16 GiB boards.

vram_safety_margin_gb.description: Emitted memory.vram_safety_margin_gb (GiB). Champion-proven 2.25; KV-tiering device pools allocate OUTSIDE the VramAllocator carve, i.e. out of this margin (kv_tiering_manager.cpp:189-245).

non_tp_overhead_gib.description: VRAM reserve on a GPU with no pinned weights (CUDA context + NCCL + transfer staging) before its expert capacity is counted.

host_pin_fraction_total.description: fraction_total for host pinned expert-arena sizing on DDR nodes (per-NUMA-node capacity is the real ceiling, INV-4.12f).

hbm_spill_fraction_free.description: fraction_free for CPU-less HBM spill banks. 0.8 measured too tight (node-local OOM with 30 GB free system-wide); 0.6 works. Registry row hbm-fraction-free-06.

min_seq_for_pairing.description: K1 split policy: a total-active-context lever of at least 2x this splits into 2 concurrent requests (headroom for a second sequence).

device_pool_round_pages.description: Tiered-KV device pool page rounding granule for the derived max_pages_per_gpu.

expert_gib_quantum.description: Per-GPU expert_streaming override rounding quantum (GiB) — keeps derived recipes hand-readable.

min_max_seq.description: E1 degradation floor for max_sequence_length before the solver refuses instead.

moe_fit_fixed_attn_mib.description: P-31 free-at-fit anchor, attention-host class (MiB): CUDA ctx + arena page tables + lazy modules between physical VRAM and the modeled free at the MoE-big fit check. Calibrated to P-30 step 2's measured 5090 free 1668 MiB at the champion carve (fixed = BAR1 - block - prefit - free). Heuristic on other boards.

moe_fit_fixed_expert_mib.description: P-31 free-at-fit anchor, expert-only class (MiB); calibrated to P-30 step 2's measured 5080 free 1685 MiB at the champion carve.

moe_fit_headroom_cushion.description: Derived moe_big_fit_headroom_mb = post-check allocation demand (block tables, logits, KVT union, MoE persistent set) x this cushion — the fit check runs BEFORE those allocations, so the headroom is what reserves their room (command_dispatcher.cpp:497-521).

moe_fit_free_floor_mib.description: Residual free-VRAM floor required after all runtime allocations when the derived stride stays at the chunk floor (the engine's fit gate is skipped there).

runtime_margin_quantum_gb.description: Rounding quantum (GiB) for the raised TP-rank safety_margin_gb (TD-AUTOCONFIG-LONGCTX-RUNTIME-SCRATCH charge).

stride_margin_cap_gb.description: Never raise a TP-rank margin above this to fund a larger prefill superchunk stride — bounds the expert-VRAM spend of the SPEED-axis stride derivation (TD-AUTOCONFIG-STRIDE-NOT-DERIVED).

block_table_budget_gb.description: dev_block_tables budget per TP rank ((layers+nextn) x max_batch x pages x 4 B, command_dispatcher.cpp:1359): the derived orchestrator.max_batch_size is the largest halving of the family cap that fits (P-29 audit: 512 @1M = 5.75 GiB, undeployable).
